svg.text: The board as built - logic side
The same connections as pages 9 to 13, by row and column
Every wire that leaves the board for the ESP32 crosses
the bottom rails on its way out. That is what a jumper
does; it lies on top of them and touches nothing.
ROW AND COLUMN NUMBERS ARE LAYOUT, NOT CHECKED FACTS. The pins on this page are parsed
from hal/pins.h and BENCH_WIRING.md and cross-checked; no source says which HOLE anything
sits in, so nothing verifies that. Build it elsewhere on the board and the electrical
pages are still true while these numbers are not.
LOST Swan module V1 · generated by tools/wiringgen.py from hal/pins.h + docs/BENCH_WIRING.md
